name: dreamfab
description: Dreamfab 造夢廠, an AI agent framework for making video (AutoIP is its first generation engine): one sentence and you direct and produce. Short dramas (script, cast, each character's own voice, edit, subtitles, covers), music videos (storyboard, lip-sync, beat-synced edit, kinetic lyrics, thumbnails), explainers (narration, MOSS-Image paintings with pans and zooms, the MV as the music bed) and ads (products, services and brands in several languages, a look per market, 30 s and 15 s cuts in three sizes), with one shared core for jobs, credits, GPU enhancement, the library and YouTube.
